climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Chardonnay and Cabernet Franc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A state whose wine was historically made from native grapes such as Vitis labrusca, though hybrids and vinifera are now common. It had 280 commercial wineries in 2018. Riesling and Vidal are the most planted grapes.
